incidents.title: Iran Says Tanker Carrying LNG Hit Mine, Suffered Explosion in Hormuz
incidents.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards navy said a tanker carrying liquefied natural gas struck a naval mine and suffered an explosion in the Strait of Hormuz on Friday while using what they described was an "unauthorized and dangerous route," state media reported.
